units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:11">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 21:9">Gen. XXI, 9</cite> <he>מצחק</he>) <he>אין הלשין הזה של צ׳ וכ׳</he> this expression of merriment (use of the root <he>צחק</he>) alludes to idolatry (by ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 32:6">Ex. XXXII, 6</cite>); … to bloodshed (by ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 2:14">II Sam. II, 14</cite>); Tanḥ. Sh’moth 1; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 6:6">Tosef. Sot. VI, 6</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 6:6">Ib.</cite>; Gen. R. l. c. <he>אין … צ׳ אלא לשון ירושה</he> this ‘merriment’ refers to the joy over the heirloom (the birth of a legitimate heir to Abraham, whereas Yishmael claimed the birthright as the firstborn).
